memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Benign positional vertigo
  - Status: New onset, episodes of spinning lasting <1 minute triggered by head movement, negative for hearing loss.
  - Plan: Start betahistine 16 mg twice daily; meclizine 25 mg SOS for acute vertigo. Perform Dix-Hallpike test today. Advise vestibular rehab exercises. Weight 68 kg, waist 86 cm (<90 cm cut‑off). Diet: Breakfast – low‑salt idli with sambar; Lunch – wheat roti, dal, vegetable curry; Dinner – light rice‑dal khichdi, avoid fried snacks. Due: HbA1c – 2025-07-05.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
betahistine 16 mg BD after food
meclizine 25 mg SOS after food

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Dix-Hallpike test: Positive on right side with torsional nystagmus lasting 10 seconds, consistent with right posterior canal BPPV.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Hemoglobin 13.8 g/dl (13-17), WBC 6.2 x10^9/l (4-10), Platelets 210 x10^9/l (150-400), Sodium 138 mmol/l (135-145), Potassium 4.2 mmol/l (3.5-5.0), Creatinine 0.9 mg/dl (0.6-1.2).

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Since starting betahistine, the spinning episodes have reduced from 4-5 per day to 1-2. Meclizine helped when I felt sudden dizziness while climbing the vegetable cart.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow-up appointment booked for 2025-07-10 at 10:00 AM with Dr Karthik Hegde (D04).

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Benign positional vertigo
  - Status: Improved, episodes now 0-2 per week, mainly after sudden head turns; no falls.
  - Plan: Continue betahistine 16 mg BD; reduce meclizine to SOS only if needed. Repeat Dix-Hallpike to assess resolution. Weight 67 kg, waist 84 cm (<90). Diet: Breakfast – poha with peanuts, low salt; Lunch – millet roti, sambar, steamed veg; Dinner – dalia khichdi, curd. Due: HbA1c – 2025-10-10.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
betahistine 16 mg BD after food
meclizine 25 mg SOS after food

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Audiometry (pure tone): Bilateral hearing thresholds within normal limits (0-25 dB HL) across 250-8000 Hz; no conductive loss.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I have occasional light‑headedness when I skip meals while working long hours at the market; otherwise vertigo is rare.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Appointment changed: original 2025-10-10 moved to 2025-12-01 at 09:30 AM with Dr Karthik Hegde (D04).

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Benign positional vertigo
  - Status: Stable, rare brief dizzy spells (<1 per month) linked to prolonged fasting; no nausea.
  - Plan: Continue betahistine 16 mg BD; advise regular meals and hydration. Consider vestibular rehab if symptoms increase. Weight 66 kg, waist 82 cm (<90). Diet: Breakfast – upma with veggies, low salt; Lunch – jowar roti, pulse curry, salad; Dinner – light vegetable pulao, curd. Due: HbA1c – 2026-03-01.
